name: Wallet
description: Adds seven coin denominations (1/5/10/20/50/100/500) that generate in village, dungeon, and structure loot, plus a Coin Sack that stores them in its own 21-slot screen with auto-pickup and a running total. Coins can be exchanged between denominations at a crafting table. Three enchantments add ownership and risk: Owner Binding locks a sack to its owner, Wallet Guardian saves it on death, and Fragility spills its contents. A full reimplementation of the Wallet datapack as a real mod - no companion resource pack needed.
